questions.question: What did God tell Habakkuk to do with the vision?
options: Burn it up in the fire entirely, for the vision will surely never once come true
Keep it hidden away and tightly sealed up until the great and final day of judgment
Proclaim it at once aloud to all of the many nations of the whole wide earth
Write it down and make it plain on tablets, for it awaits its appointed time
questions.answer: Write it down and make it plain on tablets, for it awaits its appointed time

questions.question: What famous statement of faith appears in Habakkuk 2?
options: The righteous shall live by his faith
The proud of heart shall surely fall
Seek the LORD, and you shall find him
The wicked shall prosper for a season
questions.answer: The righteous shall live by his faith

questions.question: Habakkuk 2 says the earth will be filled with the knowledge of the glory of the LORD as the waters cover the sea.
The righteous shall live by his _____.
The LORD is in His holy temple; let all the earth be _____ before Him.
